testimonials.quote: The basketball coaches, Robinson & Dweck at Lace Up are outstanding. Their dedication, professionalism and ability to connect with the players truly set them apart. They create a positive, motivating environment while teaching strong fundamentals, discipline, teamwork and confidence. Every practice is organized, energetic and focused on helping each athlete improve. Coach Robinson and Coach Dweck are patient, encouraging and genuinely invested in the growth and success of every player both on and off the court. We've had an amazing experience with Lace Up and highly recommend their program to any family looking for quality basketball training and mentorship.

Our daughter has excelled at Lace Up, each year improving physically and mentally. She now plays basketball at the collegiate level which Lace Up had a part in helping build the foundation for her success. We are grateful for all their help through the years.

Lace Up Basketball is a great program for anyone looking to develop their game and become more serious about basketball. Coach Robinson and Coach Vaughn are amazing. My daughter has improved so much in the past year. The program is affordable and flexible giving you the option to go up to 4 days a week; you choose what works for your schedule. I highly recommend Lace Up Basketball!
Lace Up is such a great program and community with excellent coaches that have helped me tremendously with not only my basketball skills, but also my confidence as a player.

I've been training with Lace Up since 5th grade, and the impact the program has had on my basketball career has been incredible. They prepared me for the next level and gave me the skills and mindset needed to play college basketball. I would highly recommend the program to any player who is serious about improving their game.

LaceUp has been a great experience for me as a player. I've grown so much through the program and have been going since elementary school all the way through college. The coaches really love the game and every single player with all their heart — they would even go out of their way to watch my games. I highly recommend LaceUp to any player looking to grow and improve.
